device.title: Select your heat pump
device.description: Recognized Aqua Temp units are listed first, followed by other nearby Bluetooth devices (nearest first). If your unit is missing, put it in pairing mode — hold the panel button for about 5 seconds until the display shows "bLE" blinking once per second — then go back and scan again.

scan.title: Scanning
scan.description: Looking for nearby Bluetooth devices. This takes about {seconds} seconds…

no_devices.title: No Aqua Temp unit found
no_devices.description:
No unconfigured Bluetooth device was seen nearby.

To make your heat pump visible:

1. Put it in pairing mode: press and hold the panel button for about 5 seconds, until the display shows "bLE" blinking once per second.
2. The unit then advertises under a name starting with "BlueNRG".
3. Close the vendor app completely — the unit accepts only one Bluetooth connection.
4. Stay within range, then scan again.

If no Bluetooth device appears at all, check that Home Assistant has a Bluetooth adapter (Settings → System → Hardware) or an active Bluetooth proxy.

manual.title: Manual address
manual.description:
Enter the Bluetooth address of the unit, e.g. `XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX`. Make sure the vendor app is closed first — the unit accepts a single connection.

Tip: if you do not know the address, put the unit in pairing mode (hold the panel button ~5 s until the display shows "bLE") and scan again.

test.title: Testing the connection
test.description: Connecting to {address} and reading the base register block (7-51). This can take about a minute.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Make sure the vendor app is closed (the unit accepts a single Bluetooth connection) and that the unit is in range, then try again.
error.no_response: The device accepted the connection but did not answer. Move closer and try again.
error.crc_error: The device replied, but the response was corrupted. Try again.
error.not_found: Home Assistant can no longer see this device nearby. Put the unit in pairing mode (hold the panel button for about 5 seconds until the display shows "bLE"), make sure it is powered on, then scan again.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already configured.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not an Aqua Temp heat pump.
abort.no_bluetooth_adapter: Home Assistant has no working Bluetooth adapter or proxy. Plug in a supported adapter (or check the Bluetooth integration), then try again. On container installs, make sure bluez and /var/run/dbus are available.
